factual_claims.source_evidence: Ratios Table: Net profit margin 6M 2026: 8.6% vs 6M 2025: 12.9%. EBITDA 6M 2026: EUR 10,300 thousand vs 6M 2025: EUR 20,100 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: In the second quarter, net profit was EUR 8.5 million, compared with EUR 11.2 million a year earlier.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Net profit Q2 2026: EUR 8,500 thousand vs Q2 2025: EUR 11,216 thousand.

factual_claims.claim: Construction services generated EUR 118.3 million of revenue, broadly in line with the prior-year period, but operating profit fell by 65.5% to EUR 3.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Reporting Table: Construction service revenue 6M 2026: EUR 118,315 thousand vs 6M 2025: EUR 120,094 thousand. Operating profit 6M 2026: EUR 3,042 thousand vs 6M 2025: EUR 8,808 thousand (65.5% decrease).

factual_claims.claim: Management attributed the decline to the expiration of successful contracts reported in earlier periods and a return to more typical margins in a highly competitive market.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Construction Service Segment text: 'The operating profit margin was mainly impacted by the expiration of successful contracts highlighted in previous periods and a return to sector's more typical margins in a highly competitive environment.'

factual_claims.claim: Real estate development revenue decreased by 33.9% to EUR 31.6 million, while operating profit fell 40.8% to EUR 7.0 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Segment Reporting Table: Real estate development revenue 6M 2026: EUR 31,578 thousand vs 6M 2025: EUR 47,788 thousand (33.9% decrease). Operating profit 6M 2026: EUR 7,021 thousand vs 6M 2025: EUR 11,862 thousand (40.8% decrease).

factual_claims.claim: Apartment sales declined to 120 from 222, although second-quarter apartment-sale revenue remained broadly stable at EUR 20.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Real Estate Development section: 'In 6 months 2026, the group sold a total of 120 apartments... in 6 months 2025, the group sold 222 apartments.' 'In Q2 of 2026 a total of 84 apartments were sold... earned a revenue of EUR 20.6 million from sale of own developed apartments (Q2 2025: EUR 20.2 million).'

factual_claims.claim: The most positive development was the order position.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'As of the end of the first half of the year, the company’s secured order-book reached an all-time high of EUR 836 million.'

factual_claims.claim: The secured order book reached a record EUR 835.7 million at 30 June, approximately 88% above the prior year, supported by EUR 486.4 million of new contracts signed during the first half.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Secured Order Book section: 'As of 30 June 2026, the group’s secured order book amounted to EUR 835.7 million, compared to EUR 443.8 million as of 30 June 2025... In 6 months 2026, EUR 486.4 million worth of new contracts were signed.'

factual_claims.claim: New second-quarter contracts included projects in Tallinn’s Krulli Quarter.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Largest Construction Contracts table lists four contracts in Estonia (Tallinn) at Krulli Quarter signed in Q2 2026 totaling EUR 41.0 + 11.6 + 7.0 + 7.0 = EUR 66.6 million.

factual_claims.claim: Construction of the Rūdninkai defence force campus also commenced at full scale after the reporting date; the two phases have a combined construction cost exceeding EUR 370 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Management Report: 'In early July, completed all preparatory stages required for the development of the Rūdninkai defence force campus project. The contract entered into full force... The construction cost of the two phases exceeds 370 million euros in total.'

factual_claims.claim: Public-sector, defence-related and Rail Baltica projects continued to support demand, while private-sector customers remained cautious.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook section: 'The growth in the public sector's share is primarily driven by Rail Baltica and defence-related contracts. Private sector clients still remain cautious... Planned high-priority public sector investments are proceeding despite the factors holding back the private sector.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 39.6 million from EUR 25.9 million, but operating cash flow worsened to negative EUR 31.6 million, primarily reflecting higher inventories and construction-contract balances.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Cash Flow Statement: Cash and cash equivalents 30.06.2026: EUR 39,593 thousand vs 30.06.2025: EUR 25,862 thousand. Cash flows from operating activities 6M 2026: negative EUR 31,602 thousand. Management Report: 'The negative effects to cash flow from operating activities came from the changes in receivables and liabilities related to construction contracts... and from the change in inventories.'

factual_claims.claim: Additional borrowing supported development activity, raising the debt ratio to 15.8% from 6.1% and net debt to EUR 29.6 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Ratios Table: Debt ratio 30.06.2026: 15.8% vs 30.06.2025: 6.1%. Cash Flow Statement: Net debt 30.06.2026: EUR 29,600 thousand vs 30.06.2025: negative EUR 1,100 thousand. Cash flows from financing activities show significant borrowing activity.

factual_claims.claim: The company invested EUR 42.6 million in development projects and paid EUR 22.1 million in dividends.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Real Estate Development section: 'In the 6 months, the group invested a total of EUR 42.6 million... in the ongoing development projects.' Dividends and Dividend Policy: 'On 28 April 2026, the shareholders... approved... to pay out the total amount of EUR 22.1 million (EUR 1.25 per share) as dividends from net profit brought forward.'

factual_claims.claim: Results remain exposed to elevated energy, labour and construction-input prices, geopolitical uncertainty and price-sensitive residential demand, although management expects moderate growth in Baltic construction markets.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Outlook section: Discusses 'inflationary pressures,' 'war with Iran,' 'energy prices above their 2025 levels,' 'geopolitical uncertainty,' and states 'We continue to view the growth outlook in our key markets positively, with moderate growth in the Baltic construction sector among our base-case expectations.'

numerical_claims.claim: Revenue for the six months was EUR 149.9 million, down 10.7% from EUR 167.9 million a year earlier.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Revenue 6 months 2026: EUR 149,893 thousand (149.9 million). Management Report: '6 months’ revenue decreased by 10.7% compared to same period last year.'

numerical_claims.claim: Second-quarter revenue, however, increased to EUR 92.7 million from EUR 82.6 million as major projects entered more active construction phases and apartment deliveries increased.
numerical_claims.label: CORRECT
numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Q2 2026 revenue EUR 92,670 thousand (92.7 million) vs Q2 2025 EUR 82,646 thousand (82.6 million).

numerical_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income: Gross profit 6M 2026: EUR 17,385 thousand (17.4 million) vs 6M 2025: EUR 29,071 thousand (29.1 million). Ratios Table confirms margin changes.
